name: fis-experiment-template-generator
description: Turns a reviewed AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) recommendation into a complete, ready-to-review FIS experiment template: the action, a tag- or COUNT/PERCENT-scoped non-production-first target selection, an ISO 8601 duration, stop conditions bound to a CloudWatch alarm, the FIS experiment IAM role reference, and logging configuration. Read-only and generate-only - it produces the template text for a human to review and deploy, never creates or starts the experiment. Recommends the awslabs FIS-recommender MCP server as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 08:00 UTC
